posts.photoClaim: open fridge with eggs, sausages, a jar of garlic, strawberries and a bag of greens
posts.head: Tonight is on shelf two

slides.head: Four dinners from one chicken.
slides.body: Swipe. One $8.99 rotisserie chicken, one bag of rice, four weeknights.

slides.photoClaim: hands carving a roast chicken on a tray beside the stove
slides.head: Night one: carve it while it's hot
slides.method: Carve the legs and a breast for tonight, then pull the rest into a container before it cools.

slides.photoClaim: hands holding a bowl of shredded chicken in tomato sauce over white rice
slides.head: Night two: saucy chicken over rice
slides.method: Simmer the shredded chicken in crushed tomatoes and garlic for ten minutes, then spoon it over rice.

slides.photoClaim: wooden bowl of sliced chicken, white rice, corn, kidney beans and shredded carrot
slides.head: Night three: chicken, rice and bean bowl
slides.method: Warm the leftover rice, open a can of beans, grate a carrot and slice the chicken on top.

slides.photoClaim: hands stirring fried rice in a pan by a kitchen window
slides.head: Night four: fried rice with the last of it
slides.method: Hot pan, day-old rice, two eggs and the last shreds of chicken. Twenty minutes and the bird is done.

Your grocery receipt is already a meal plan.
posts.body: Six items, $19.93: eggs, black beans, tortillas, spinach, feta and salsa. Scan the receipt and iEatz builds recipes from exactly that.

posts.photoClaim: open fridge with stocked shelves above a bowl of greens with soft eggs, avocado and radish
posts.cap: Nothing new came home. $0.00 spent. The bowl was in there on Sunday.

posts.photoClaim: tacos filled with roasted chickpeas, sweet potato, avocado, tomato and jalapeño, with lime squeezed over
posts.head: Roasted sweet potato and chickpea tacos
posts.method: Roast diced sweet potato and chickpeas at 425°F for about 20 minutes, then pile them into warm tortillas with avocado, jalapeño and a squeeze of lime.
